process: Generate one character at a time from its identity plus the 9-to-5er style reference. Generate alternate pose from the finished clean portrait. Export transparent generated cutouts onto exact cream, hard-alpha threshold, aspect-preserving scale, then nearest-neighbor 2x PNG. No procedural character drawing.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A clean character reference portrait for Google Flow, Midlife Survivors. Image 1 is the IDENTITY reference: retain that exact character's face, age, skin tone, outfit colors, hair, glasses, hat, accessories and friendly proportions. Image 2 is the STYLE reference: match the detailed painted 16-bit pixel illustration, chunky navy silhouette outline, stepped square pixel clusters, warm upper-left light and three-quarter elevated camera of this 9-to-5er key art. The style reference is not a costume reference for other people. No glossy 3D, no realistic rendering, no smooth painterly brush strokes, no blur or anti-aliasing. Palette targets navy #171C35, slate #303750 #526078, teal #3E7775, sage #83A89A, warm browns #A88B70 #874C3B, khaki #D3B78D, cream #F2D7A1, warm white #FFF0CF, russet #C45C4B, coffee orange #EF9347, skin #E5A995, pink #F1B5BF, lavender #BFA8CF, with reference-appropriate skin shades. Square 1024x1024. One full-body character only, facing three-quarter, whole figure including feet and headwear inside canvas with generous margin. Head and expression read clearly, mature adult and slightly oversized head like the reference. Centered composition at consistent cast scale: top of hair or hat near y150, feet near y880. Plain flat solid cream #F2D7A1 background, no scenery or horizon. Only a small soft oval contact shadow immediately under both feet, no long directional cast shadow or floor pattern. No letters, text, digits, logos, labels, UI or watermark, including on any badge.
CHARACTER AND POSE: The 9-to-5er. Middle-aged office worker with spiky messy brown hair graying at temples, thick black rectangular glasses, lightly stubbled face, cream short-sleeve dress shirt, loose russet-red tie, khaki slacks, brown belt and brown loafers. Orange mug held naturally in one hand, other hand in trouser pocket, relaxed tired-but-determined half smile. Retain recognizable mature key-art face, no rosy child face.
images.extraction_prompt: Extract this exact 9-to-5er character as a transparent cutout. Remove all cream/yellow background and the floor oval shadow. Keep all character pixels, outfit, mug, face, hair, glasses, body proportions and pose exactly unchanged. No other object. Preserve crisp pixel silhouette. Output transparent RGBA background.

A rugged middle-aged man, long wavy BROWN hair to collar with a few gray strands, subtle stubble, laid-back lopsided half-smirk and half-lidded visible eyes.
